suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 (Kotlin, code execution via unsafe deserialization of build cache metadata). Affects the Kotlin build tooling, not the kotlin-stdlib/kotlin-reflect runtime jars that ClearTH ships; the CPE cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin is matched for every Kotlin artifact, so this is a false positive for the runtime dependencies. The vendor (JetBrains, CNA) scores it CVSS 6.7 - below the failBuildOnCVSS threshold of 7.6; only the NVD re-score of 9.8 trips the build. Fixed in Kotlin 2.4.20, which has no stable release yet (latest on Maven Central: 2.4.20-RC2), so there is nothing to upgrade to. Revisit once 2.4.20 is out.

CVE-2020-29582 (Kotlin, insecure temp file permissions via createTempFile/createTempDir). Per the CVE description it affects Kotlin before 1.4.21 and is fixed there; we use 1.8.22. The NVD CPE range (kotlin < 2.1.0) is incorrect and matches every Kotlin artifact - false positive.
